title: Memory
description: ADR-0014: host-owned memory. The package proposes, records and recalls; it never accepts or stores. digest is sha256: followed by SHA-256 of UTF-8 text. Proposals use project scope, the execution id as source.run, and model as proposedBy.

id.description: 1–100 Unicode code points, including non-ASCII characters; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units.

run.description: 1–100 Unicode code points, including non-ASCII characters; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units.

createdAt.description: Calendar-valid RFC3339 date-time, year 0001–9999, seconds 00–59; T and Z may be lowercase.

expiresAt.description: Calendar-valid RFC3339 date-time, year 0001–9999, seconds 00–59; T and Z may be lowercase.

answer.description: memoryFor answers at most 256 closed Memory records; absent or null callbacks supply nothing. Bare text, including empty text, is retired in v0.9.1. Only accepted, unexpired records reach the immutable per-run prompt.

lifecycleUpdate.description: Metadata-only explicit terminal reporting for an existing canonical recalled identity. The host owns deletion; omission does not revoke. Identity, digest and kind must match; accepted becomes revoked/expired, identical terminal replay is idempotent and terminal switching refuses.

id.description: 1–100 Unicode code points, including non-ASCII characters; not UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 code units.

lifecycleAnswer.description: The optional host memoryLifecycle callback answers up to 256 closed metadata updates; absent or null supplies no updates. It is asked once even when prompt recall is disabled. All updates and full-record recall reconcile atomically against prior canonical metadata.
